<noinclude>
Stores and displays one OpenAlex subfield and lists its topics. Written by the upload bot
between the <code>BOT:BEGIN openalex</code> and <code>BOT:END openalex</code> markers.

{{#cargo_declare:_table=Subfields
|openalex_id=String
|name=String
|description=Text
|field=Page
|field_id=String
|domain=Page
|domain_id=String
|works_share=Float
|citations_share=Float
|works_permille=Float
|works_count=Integer
|cited_by_count=Integer
|wikipedia=URL
|wikidata=String
}}
</noinclude><includeonly>{{#cargo_store:_table=Subfields

== Topics ==
{{#cargo_query:tables=Topics
|fields=_pageName=Topic,works_share=Share of works (%),citations_share=Share of citations (%)
|where=subfield_id='{{{openalex_id}}}'
|order by=works_share DESC
|format=table
|limit=1000
|default=''No topics stored yet.''
}}
